evidence.note: After degree-based init gave S3=0.0104, diagnosed the E2_aligned inflation and pivoted from Python SA to a C++ SANA-style implementation for speed — a materially different tactic prompted by the shortfall.

Diagnosed that optimizing S3 directly produced near-zero gradients under the Metropolis criterion, then redesigned the objective to Ea - alpha*E2a (sana3). This is a deliberate signal/objective pivot, not just a reseed, and it improved results (0.167 climbing).

Strongest adaptation: discovered the seeded perfect alignment fails S3 (0.248<0.55); SA raised S3 to 0.572 but crashed NC to 0.09; correctly diagnosed the two-constraint conflict and built sana_nc.cpp that keeps reference seeding + constrains NC≥0.32 while topologically optimizing S3 — combining complementary signals for the two constraints. Passed both (S3=0.556, NC=0.32).

Repeatedly diagnosed the DM-HS ~0.28 plateau and proposed genuinely different tactics (dense-subgraph image selection, 3-cycle rotation moves, GDV signatures, literature methods) but never implemented them — instead grinding many long/multi-start SA runs for marginal gains (0.267→0.282), i.e., not abandoning the dead-end approach quickly.

Even after the yeast success demonstrated the value of good seeding, DM-HS response was to launch 4 parallel SA runs with different seeds/schedules (a level-3-style reseed) which all plateaued at ~0.27, showing incomplete follow-through on the deeper diagnosed pivots.

reasoning: The agent clearly diagnoses shortfalls and pivots deliberately in several places — changing algorithm (degree→SA→C++), changing the optimization signal (S3→Ea-αE2a), and, most convincingly for y2kr-SC, diagnosing the NC-vs-S3 conflict and combining reference seeding with an NC-constrained topological search (level-8 behavior). But on DM-HS the fundamentally different strategies it kept proposing were never executed; instead it ground the same SA family through many long/multi-start runs for tiny gains and did not abandon that dead end, which falls short of the fluid, quick-abandonment level-10 behavior. Weighing a genuine, complete diagnostic pivot on one deliverable against persistent grinding on the other lands the observed level at 7.
